types.name: Main idea or title
types.description: Asks what the passage as a whole is mainly about, its central theme, or the most suitable title for it.

types.name: Fact from the passage
types.description: Asks for a fact stated directly in the passage, usually worded 'According to the passage…', 'What/when/why/how…' or 'Which of the following is true as per the passage?'.

types.name: NOT true or EXCEPT
types.description: Asks which option is NOT true, NOT mentioned, or is the EXCEPTION among statements about the passage.

types.name: Inference
types.description: Asks what can be inferred, what the passage suggests or implies, what the author would most likely agree or disagree with, or what a phrase most likely suggests.

types.name: Tone and attitude
types.description: Asks for the tone of the passage or the author's attitude, feeling or point of view towards a subject (e.g. critical, optimistic, neutral).

types.name: Author's purpose
types.description: Asks why the author wrote the passage, why a particular example or fact is mentioned, or what role a sentence or paragraph plays.

types.name: Word in context
types.description: Asks for the meaning, synonym or antonym of a word or phrase as it is used in the passage.
